findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed unwrapped drinking straws in holders on the bar top. The straws are not properly protected. Straws can be provided as wrapped, provided in a dispenser that protects the food and lip contact surfaces or the current containers can be moved to the back bar or a location that protects them. Protect straws by the next routine inspection.  

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11: Observed a plastic funnel in basin of bar hand sink. Funnel was removed. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
